markers.note: The guideline gives LDL goals by risk group (3.0 low / 2.6 moderate / 1.8 high / 1.4 very high). The app cannot assess risk (MDR rule), so the bar shows the two goals for people without known disease and says a doctor decides which applies. Cautious default: "usual" (labels on) only below 2.6, not 3.0.
Guideline gives no non-HDL goal for low risk; 3.4 (moderate) is the highest goal it gives. No doctor zone: no source sets one.

ESC 2019 sets no HDL goal. The EAS/EFLM lab flag is ≤1.0; its Table 5 footnote allows sex-specific cut-offs but gives no number for women. Pass 2: a single 1.0 is the less cautious choice for women. No doctor flag depends on HDL. Open for Justina: keep 1.0 for everyone, or drop the HDL zones and show the value with the no-goal text only.

flags.when: total >= 7.5 and not flag(fh_by_ldl) and not flag(fh_by_ldl_on_medicine)
flags.when_mg_dl: total >= 290 and not flag(fh_by_ldl) and not flag(fh_by_ldl_on_medicine)

flags.when: (family_early_chd == yes or family_known_fh == yes) and not any_flag_of(fh_by_ldl, fh_by_ldl_on_medicine, fh_by_total)

claims.population: adults; goals by cardiovascular risk group

quotes.quote: For individuals at low risk, an LDL-C goal of <3.0 mmol/L (<116 mg/dL) may be considered.
For individuals at moderate risk, an LDL-C goal of <2.6 mmol/L (<100 mg/dL) should be considered.
For patients at high risk, an LDL-C reduction of ≥50% from baseline and an LDL-C goal of <1.8 mmol/L (<70 mg/dL) are recommended.
For secondary prevention in very-high-risk patients, an LDL-C reduction of ≥50% from baseline and an LDL-C goal of <1.4 mmol/L (<55 mg/dL) are recommended.
It is important to note that the LDL-C treatment goals (Figure 1) and therapeutic guidance (Table 4) for persons in each risk category have not changed from the 2019 ESC/EAS Guidelines.

claims.cautious_default: Bar boundary for 'in the guideline range' set at 2.6 (moderate-risk goal) rather than 3.0, because the app cannot tell who is low risk.

claims.population: adults; very high / high / moderate risk

quotes.quote: Non-HDL-C secondary goals are <2.2, 2.6, and 3.4 mmol/L (<85, 100, and 130 mg/dL) for very-high-, high-, and moderate-risk people, respectively.
No goal, but <1.7 mmol/L (<150 mg/dL) indicates lower risk and higher levels indicate a need to look for other risk factors.

claims.population: adults; lab flag, not a treatment goal

quotes.quote: HDL cholesterol ≤1 mmol/L (40 mg/dL)
To date, no specific goals for HDL-C or TG levels have been determined in clinical trials

claims.population: adults; lab flag, not a treatment goal

quotes.quote: total cholesterol ≥5 mmol/L (190 mg/dL)
The risk of pancreatitis is clinically significant if TGs are >10 mmol/L (880 mg/dL)
Life-threatening concentrations require separate referral when triglycerides >10 mmol/L (880 mg/dL) for the risk of pancreatitis

claims.cautious_default: Sources say >10 (880 mg/dL); the app flags at 10 or higher (sends people sooner), and the card says so. Time frame 'today or tomorrow' is in no source: cautious default from design.

quotes.quote: Elevations of chylomicrons typically are present when triglycerides are ≥500 mg/dL (≥5.6 mmol/L), and chylomicronemia may cause acute pancreatitis.
To prevent acute pancreatitis, it is reasonable to reduce triglycerides whenever levels exceed 500 mg/dL (5.6 mmol/L).
When non-fasting plasma triglyceride concentration >5 mmol/L (440 mg/dL), consideration should be given to repeating the lipid profile in the fasting state

claims.cautious_default: Time frame 'in the next few weeks' is in no source: cautious default from design. The 5.6 level is defined on fasting samples; the app applies it to any sample, which flags more people (cautious). The doctor can repeat a fasting test.

quotes.quote: Severe Hypercholesterolemia (LDL-C ≥190 mg/dL [≥4.9 mmol/L])
in people with severely elevated LDL-C [in adults >5 mmol/L (>190 mg/dL), in children >4 mmol/L (>150 mg/dL)], and in first-degree relatives of FH patients.

claims.cautious_default: ESC 2019 says >5 mmol/L (>190 mg/dL); AHA/ACC 2018 says ≥4.9 (≥190 mg/dL). The app uses ≥4.9, the lower. The card names no condition.

quotes.quote: a total cholesterol level greater than 7.5 mmol/l
plasma cholesterol level in an adult ≥8 mmol/L(≥310 mg/dL)

claims.cautious_default: NICE says >7.5; EAS 2013 says ≥8. The app uses ≥7.5, the most cautious, and the card says '7.5 or higher' (draft 4). NICE 1.1.1 applies total cholesterol on its own, so the rule also fires when LDL is known and below 4.9 (QA question 3 for the clinician).

claims.population: adults with a parent, brother, sister or child who had heart disease young, or a relative with known FH

quotes.quote: a personal or family history of premature coronary heart disease (an event before 60 years in an index individual or first-degree relative).
in people with relatives with premature fatal or non-fatal CVD
and in first-degree relatives of FH patients.

claims.note: Supports the S4 question wording 'before 60' for a parent, brother, sister or child.

quotes.quote: With high TG values (>4.5 mmol/L or >400 mg/dL) the formula cannot be used.
ApoB analysis is recommended for risk assessment, particularly in people with high TG levels
Both cholesterol and triglycerides rise with pregnancy
Cholesterol: 1 mmol/L = 38.67 mg/dL.
To convert to mmol/L, the values in mg/dL for TC, LDL-C, HDL-C, and non–HDL-C were divided by 38.6 and for triglycerides, by 88.6.
quotes.locator: §1.1 methods, PDF p. 5 (applies to the whole guideline)

claims.note: No stored source states 88.57. Using 88.6 changes a converted value by under 0.05%.

quotes.quote: For general risk screening, non-fasting samples seem to have at least the same prognostic value as fasting samples.
Fasting is not routinely required for determination of a lipid profile
Based on prevalences between 1/500 and 1/200, between 14 and 34 million individuals worldwide have FH.

claims.note: General 'Why might it be high?' screen only, never next to a person's numbers (QA A3). Not a lab threshold, so under the strict rule this needs Justina's OK on consensus statements, or it is dropped.

quotes.quote: for each 1 mmol/L reduction in LDL-C, statin/more statin reduced major vascular events (MI, CAD death, or any stroke or coronary revascularization) by 22%

claims.note: Statin trials. Shown without a number and never on habit screens (QA).

quotes.quote: Reduce dietary saturated fats
quotes.locator: Table 8, 'reduce TC and LDL-C' block: ++, level A

quotes.quote: The magnitude of the effect (+++ = >10%, ++ = 5–10%, + = <5%)

Unsaturated fat-rich oils from safflower, sunflower, rapeseed, flaxseed, corn, olives, or soybean were shown to reduce LDL-C levels (-0.42 to -0.20 mmol/L) when used in substitution of SFA-rich foods like butter or lard.

claims.note: 'LDL often 5–10% lower' is back: ESC Table 8 rates this change '++' = 5–10%. Hooper 2020 no longer needed.

quotes.quote: Available evidence consistently demonstrates a TC- and LDL-C-lowering effect of β-glucan, a viscous fibre from oat and barley.
the dosage needed to achieve a clinically relevant reduction in levels of LDL-C of 3–5% varies from 3–10 g per day according to the specific type of fibre.

claims.note: Replaces Whitehead 2014 (no stored copy) as the carrying source. The 3–5% applies to oat and barley (β-glucan) fibre at 3–10 g a day; the cards say so.

quotes.quote: Alcohol intake has a [...] major impact on TG levels, particularly in individuals with HTG.
Reduce alcohol intake
Soft drinks should be used with moderation by the general population, and should be drastically limited in those individuals with elevated TG values or visceral adiposity.
Reduce intake of mono- and disaccharides
Weight reduction improves insulin sensitivity and decreases TG levels.
Regular physical exercise reduces plasma TG levels over and above the effect of weight reduction.
Increase habitual physical activity
quotes.locator: Table 8, 'reduce TC and LDL-C' block: + (<5%), level B

quotes.quote: Aerobic physical activity, such as 25–30 km of brisk walking per week (or any equivalent activity), may increase HDL-C levels by 0.08–0.15 mmol/L (3.1–6 mg/dL).
Smoking cessation has clear benefits regarding overall CV risk, and specifically on HDL-C levels.
Smoking cessation may also contribute to HDL-C elevation, provided that weight gain is prevented.
Dietary supplements or vitamins without documented safety and significant LDL-C-lowering efficacy are not recommended to lower the risk of [...] ASCVD.
quotes.locator: Recommendation Table 8 (Class III, Level B; class/level cells interrupt the text)

quotes.quote: Once the index case is diagnosed, family cascade screening is recommended.

claims.note: Supports testing relatives only once a doctor has diagnosed inherited high cholesterol in a family member (pass 2 fix).

quotes.quote: Quantitatively, dietary trans fatty acids have a similar elevating effect on LDL-C to that of SFAs; however, while SFAs increase HDL-C levels, trans fats decrease them.
Avoid dietary trans fats
quotes.locator: Table 8: ++ (5–10%) level A for LDL-C, ++ level A for HDL-C

quotes.quote: ‘Partially hydrogenated fatty acids’ of industrial origin represent the major source of trans fatty acids in the diet
Trans fats and hard margarines
quotes.locator: Table 9, cooking fat row, column 'to be chosen occasionally in limited amounts', marked '(better to avoid them)'

quotes.quote: Dietary fibre (particularly of the soluble type)—which is present in legumes, fruits, vegetables, and wholegrain cereals (e.g. oats and barley)—has a hypocholesterolaemic effect
Increase dietary fibre

claims.note: The 3–5% shown on the card comes from claim_fibre_ldl (§7.5.3, at 3–10 g fibre a day). Table 8's '++' is the broader 'increase dietary fibre'; the card uses the smaller, more specific figure so oats are not overstated (QA A4).

quotes.quote: Weight reduction increases HDL-C levels; a 0.01 mmol/L (0.4 mg/dL) increase is observed for every kilogram decrease in body weight when weight reduction has stabilized.
Body weight reduction also influences TC and LDL-C levels, but the magnitude of the effect is small
Reduce excessive body weight
quotes.locator: Table 8: LDL-C ++ A; TG + A; HDL-C ++ A

quotes.quote: Response to therapy can be assessed at 6–8 weeks from initiation of therapy, but response to lifestyle may take longer.
Recommendations stem from consensus rather than evidence-based medicine.

Adherence to changes in lifestyle and effects of LDL-C–lowering medication should be assessed by measurement of fasting lipids and appropriate safety indicators 4 to 12 weeks after statin initiation or dose adjustment

claims.note: No stored source sets a re-test interval for lifestyle change. ESC's 8 (±4) weeks and AHA/ACC's 4–12 weeks are for after starting or changing medicine (AHA/ACC names lifestyle too, but its clock starts at the statin). The only lifestyle-only window, AHA/ACC's "3 to 6 months of lifestyle therapy", is for children with very high LDL before a statin decision, not an adult re-test. ESC says lifestyle response "may take longer". So the pack sets no interval: the person picks their own date (ideally with their doctor). The date picker starts empty, with no pre-filled suggestion (QA LV1).
No stored source gives a number for test-to-test variation. Before/after shows numbers and the difference only.

intended_purpose.en: An educational tool, not a medical advisor. It shares published guidelines on blood lipids in short, plain words, with links so anyone can read the sources themselves, and helps people build healthier habits. It does not diagnose, assess risk or recommend treatment.
intended_purpose.lt: Šviečiamoji priemonė, ne medicinos patarėja. Ji trumpai ir paprastai perteikia paskelbtas kraujo lipidų gaires su nuorodomis, kad kiekvienas galėtų šaltinius perskaityti pats, ir padeda kurti sveikesnius įpročius. Ji nediagnozuoja ligų, nevertina rizikos ir nerekomenduoja gydymo.

about_privacy.en: Your numbers stay in this browser on this phone. There are no accounts, no analytics and no ads, and the app sends nothing anywhere after it has loaded.

about_disclaimer.en: This app explains lab numbers and what published guidelines say about them. It is not a diagnosis and does not replace a doctor. If you take medicine for cholesterol, keep taking it as prescribed. If you feel unwell, contact your doctor; in an emergency call 112.
about_disclaimer.lt: Ši programėlė paaiškina tyrimų skaičius ir tai, ką apie juos sako paskelbtos gairės. Tai ne diagnozė, ir ji nepakeičia gydytojo. en.helper: If a doctor diagnoses inherited high cholesterol in someone in their family, guidelines recommend testing that person's close relatives too.

lt.helper: Jei gydytojas kuriam nors šio žmogaus šeimos nariui nustato paveldimą didelį cholesterolį, gairės rekomenduoja ištirti ir jo artimuosius giminaičius.

en.self: When triglycerides are above 4.5 mmol/L, the usual way labs calculate LDL cannot be used, so this LDL figure may be less accurate. You could ask about a direct LDL or ApoB test.

lt.self: Kai trigliceridų yra daugiau nei 4,5 mmol/l, įprastu laboratorijos skaičiavimo būdu MTL nustatyti negalima, todėl šis MTL rezultatas gali būti mažiau tikslus. Galite paklausti apie tiesioginį MTL arba ApoB tyrimą.

en.self: You said a doctor has told you about heart disease, stroke, diabetes or kidney disease. Your doctor sets your LDL target.
en.helper: You said a doctor has told them about heart disease, stroke, diabetes or kidney disease. Their doctor sets their LDL target.

lt.self: Nurodėte, kad gydytojas jums yra minėjęs širdies ligą, insultą, diabetą ar inkstų ligą. Jūsų MTL tikslą nustato gydytojas.
lt.helper: Nurodėte, kad gydytojas šiam žmogui yra minėjęs širdies ligą, insultą, diabetą ar inkstų ligą. Šio žmogaus MTL tikslą nustato gydytojas.

en.self: Cholesterol and triglycerides rise in pregnancy. Your midwife or doctor will interpret these results.
en.helper: Cholesterol and triglycerides rise in pregnancy. Their midwife or doctor will interpret these results.

lt.self: Nėštumo metu cholesterolio ir trigliceridų kiekis padidėja. Šiuos rezultatus įvertins jūsų akušerė ar gydytojas.
lt.helper: Nėštumo metu cholesterolio ir trigliceridų kiekis padidėja. Šiuos rezultatus įvertins jos akušerė ar gydytojas.

en.self: Guidelines set much lower LDL goals for people with heart disease, stroke or diabetes, often below 1.8 or 1.4 mmol/L. Bring these results to your doctor.
en.helper: Guidelines set much lower LDL goals for people with heart disease, stroke or diabetes, often below 1.8 or 1.4 mmol/L. They can bring these results to their doctor.

lt.self: Žmonėms su širdies liga, po insulto ar su diabetu gairės nustato daug mažesnius MTL tikslus, dažnai mažiau nei 1,8 arba 1,4 mmol/l. Aptarkite šiuos rezultatus su gydytoju.
lt.helper: Žmonėms su širdies liga, po insulto ar su diabetu gairės nustato daug mažesnius MTL tikslus, dažnai mažiau nei 1,8 arba 1,4 mmol/l. Šiuos rezultatus verta aptarti su gydytoju.

str_fasting_fact.en: You usually don't need to fast before a cholesterol test.
str_fasting_fact.lt: Prieš cholesterolio tyrimą paprastai nebūtina būti nevalgius.

str_fh_prevalence.en: Inherited high cholesterol affects somewhere between 1 in 500 and 1 in 200 people.
str_fh_prevalence.lt: Paveldimas didelis cholesterolis pasitaiko maždaug nuo 1 iš 500 iki 1 iš 200 žmonių.

str_why_ldl_matters.en: The guidelines rest on large trials in which lowering LDL led to fewer heart attacks and strokes.
str_why_ldl_matters.lt: Gairės remiasi dideliais tyrimais, kuriuose sumažinus MTL buvo mažiau infarktų ir insultų.

effect_ldl_swap_sat_fat.en: Swap butter and lard for plant oils such as rapeseed, sunflower or olive oil. Mainly moves LDL, often 5–10% lower.
effect_ldl_swap_sat_fat.lt: Sviestą ir taukus pakeiskite augaliniais aliejais, pavyzdžiui, rapsų, saulėgrąžų ar alyvuogių. Daugiausia veikia MTL, dažnai jis sumažėja 5–10 %.

effect_ldl_oats.en: Oats or barley every day. Their fibre lowers LDL a little, by about 3–5% when you eat enough of it.
effect_ldl_oats.lt: Kasdien valgykite avižų ar miežių. Jų skaidulos šiek tiek sumažina MTL, maždaug 3–5 %, kai jų suvalgoma pakankamai.

effect_tg_alcohol.en: Drink less alcohol. Alcohol has a large effect on triglycerides.
effect_tg_alcohol.lt: Gerkite mažiau alkoholio. Alkoholis stipriai veikia trigliceridus.

effect_tg_sweet_drinks.en: Cut down on sugary drinks and sugar. Guidelines advise this especially when triglycerides are high.
effect_tg_sweet_drinks.lt: Mažiau gėrimų su cukrumi ir cukraus. Gairės tai ypač rekomenduoja, kai trigliceridų daug.

effect_tg_weight.en: If you carry extra weight, losing some lowers triglycerides.
effect_tg_weight.lt: Jei turite antsvorio, šiek tiek numetus svorio trigliceridų sumažėja.

effect_tg_exercise.en: Move more, for example brisk walks. Regular exercise lowers triglycerides, on top of any effect from weight loss. It also lowers LDL slightly and raises HDL a little.
effect_tg_exercise.lt: Judėkite daugiau, pavyzdžiui, sparčiai vaikščiokite. Reguliarus fizinis aktyvumas mažina trigliceridus net ir nepriklausomai nuo svorio metimo, šiek tiek sumažina MTL ir šiek tiek padidina DTL.

effect_smoking_vessels.en: If you smoke, stopping is good for your heart and blood vessels, and may raise HDL a little.
effect_smoking_vessels.lt: Jei rūkote, mesti naudinga širdžiai ir kraujagyslėms, be to, gali šiek tiek padidėti DTL.

str_supplements_answer.en: European guidelines (2025) do not recommend dietary supplements or vitamins for heart health unless they are proven to do no harm and to lower LDL clearly.
str_supplements_answer.lt: Europos gairės (2025) nerekomenduoja maisto papildų ar vitaminų širdies sveikatai, jei neįrodyta, kad jie nekenkia ir aiškiai mažina MTL.

lever_heading.en: Options that often help people with results like these
lever_heading.lt: Galimybės, kurios dažnai padeda žmonėms su tokiais rezultatais

lever_alongside_doctor.en: These work alongside a doctor's advice, not instead of it.
lever_alongside_doctor.lt: Tai papildo gydytojo patarimus, bet jų nepakeičia.

lever_swap_sat_fat_title.en: Swap butter and lard for plant oils
lever_swap_sat_fat_title.lt: Sviestą ir taukus keiskite augaliniais aliejais

lever_more_fibre_title.en: Eat more fibre: oats, barley, beans and lentils
lever_more_fibre_title.lt: Valgykite daugiau skaidulų: avižų, miežių, pupelių ir lęšių

lever_more_fibre_text.en: Fibre from oats, barley, beans, lentils, vegetables and wholegrains lowers LDL. Oat and barley fibre lowers it by about 3–5% when you eat enough of it every day.
lever_more_fibre_text.lt: Skaidulos iš avižų, miežių, pupelių, lęšių, daržovių ir viso grūdo produktų mažina MTL. Avižų ir miežių skaidulos jį sumažina maždaug 3–5 %, kai jų kasdien suvalgoma pakankamai.

lever_avoid_trans_fat_title.en: Avoid trans fats and hard margarine

lever_avoid_trans_fat_text.en: Trans fats raise LDL about as much as saturated fat does, and they also lower HDL. Look for 'partially hydrogenated' on labels.
lever_avoid_trans_fat_text.lt: Transriebalai MTL padidina maždaug tiek pat, kiek sotieji riebalai, be to, sumažina DTL. Etiketėse ieškokite žodžių „iš dalies hidrinti“.

lever_less_alcohol_title.en: Drink less alcohol, if you drink

lever_cut_sweet_drinks_title.en: Cut down on sugary drinks and sugar
lever_cut_sweet_drinks_title.lt: Mažiau gėrimų su cukrumi ir cukraus

lever_move_more_title.en: Move more, for example brisk walks

lever_lose_weight_title.en: Lose some weight, if you carry extra
lever_lose_weight_title.lt: Numeskite šiek tiek svorio, jei jo turite per daug

lever_lose_weight_text.en: Losing weight lowers triglycerides, lowers LDL a little and raises HDL a little.
lever_lose_weight_text.lt: Numetus svorio sumažėja trigliceridų, šiek tiek sumažėja MTL ir šiek tiek padidėja DTL.

en.self: The guidelines we use set no re-test date for lifestyle changes on their own. They say changes may take longer than the 6–8 weeks used for medicine. Pick a date that suits you, ideally with your doctor.
en.helper: The guidelines we use set no re-test date for lifestyle changes on their own. They say changes may take longer than the 6–8 weeks used for medicine. Pick a date that suits them, ideally with their doctor.

lt.self: Mūsų naudojamos gairės nenustato, kada pakartoti tyrimą vien pakeitus gyvenseną. Jose nurodoma, kad pokyčiai gali užtrukti ilgiau nei vaistams taikomos 6–8 savaitės. Pasirinkite jums tinkamą datą, geriausia kartu su gydytoju.
